entries.title: Stable releases include Infinitary for Windows, as an experimental download
entries.body: Every stable release now carries the installer for Windows 11 on 64-bit Intel and AMD PCs, marked experimental. It is not yet signed with a certificate Microsoft verifies, so Windows warns before it runs, and a PC with Smart App Control on blocks it until the signed build. A Windows PC on the Stable channel now gets Update and restart for each new stable.
entries.noPicture: No view changes: a Windows copy on the Stable channel shows the existing update offer instead of saying no release is available yet.
